title: His tours of Europe starting in 1932
summary: He counts eight or ten European trips, first in 1932, staying over a year, returning in 1935.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Louie, how many tours have you made to Europe now?

Oh, I've been going along about eight or ten times in different times. It was jazz festivals and things. You went over in 32 the first time. First time, 32. Then I would come back, and I went back and stayed over a year or so, and come back in 35. And then from then on, we was going over for different events.
